text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the end of the year fast approaching, 
you invited Cheval Grand out sea fishing 
to talk about her goals for the Senior 
class.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the midst of that, a fan called out to 
Cheval Grand. Seeing her respond 
positively, unlike before, showed just how 
much she had grown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After fishing, they discuss Senior year 
goals. If she wants to go head-to-head 
with Kitasan Black at full power, she must 
get used to long distances and build race 
momentum.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black is set to run the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)— First, she sets her sights 
firmly on winning its trial race, the 
Hanshin Daishoten.
